signatureEngine.name: 飞鸟星梦
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 银刺幽羽
refinements.description: 属性异常积蓄效率提升40%；装备者造成以太伤害时，自身异常精通提升20点，持续5秒，最多叠加6层，0.5秒内最多触发一次，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Anomaly Buildup Rate by 40%. When the equipper deals Ether DMG, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 20 for 5s, stacking up to 6 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

refinements.name: 银刺幽羽
refinements.description: 属性异常积蓄效率提升46%；装备者造成以太伤害时，自身异常精通提升23点，持续5秒，最多叠加6层，0.5秒内最多触发一次，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Anomaly Buildup Rate by 46%. When the equipper deals Ether DMG, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 23 for 5s, stacking up to 6 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

basic.name: 普通攻击：翎羽拂击
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
发动第四段攻击后进入[淑女礼仪]状态；
拥有[飞羽]时，在第四段攻击过程中保持按住 【普通攻击键】 可进入[裙裾浮游]状态。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
After triggering the fourth attack, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, holding [Basic Attack] during the fourth attack will activate the Fluttering Frock state.

special.name: 特殊技：银羽咏叹
special.nameEn: Special Attack: Song of Silver Wings
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速向前方进行攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly attack forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：堇花悼亡
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力攻击，造成大量以太伤害，并回复3点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 进入[淑女礼仪]状态。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a powerful forward attack that deals massive Ether DMG and grants 3 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Enter the Fluttering Frock state after using the skill. Hold [Dodge] during the skill to enter the Noblewoman state.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：羽刃反振
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[淑女礼仪]状态；
拥有[飞羽]时，在招式发动过程中保持按住 【普通攻击键】 可进入[裙裾浮游]状态。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After activating the skill, enter the Noblewoman state.
When there are Flight Feathers available, hold [Basic Attack] during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

chain.name: 连携技：星羽和声
chain.nameEn: Chain Attack: Chorus of Celestial Wings
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力攻击，造成大量以太伤害，并回复2点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 取消。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge] during the skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：飞鸟鸣颂
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力攻击，造成大量以太伤害，并回复5点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 取消。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 5 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill is activated, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge] during the skill.

quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:

quickAssist.descriptionEn:

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：银伞列阵
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:

招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.descriptionEn:

facts.text:
[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，相对于原属性异常伤害的比例为每10点异常精通6.15%/3.2%/8%/0.75%/1.08%/0.32%；
[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]或[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中处于任意属性异常状态的目标时，使目标陷入[薇薇安的预言]，每0.55秒受到薇薇安55%攻击力的以太伤害，该伤害可以触发属性异常效果的额外伤害；当目标不再处于属性异常状态时，[薇薇安的预言]结束；
进入战场时，薇薇安获得2点[飞羽]。
facts.textEn:
When Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 6.15%/3.2%/8%/0.75%/1.08%/0.32% per 10 points of Anomaly Proficiency of the original Anomaly's DMG.
When Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension or Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering any Attribute Anomaly, apply Vivian's Prophecy to the target, causing the target to take Ether DMG equal to 55% of Vivian's ATK every 0.55s. This DMG can trigger the additional DMG of Attribute Anomalies. When the enemy is no longer suffering an Attribute Anomaly, Vivian's Prophecy expires.
Upon entering the battlefield, Vivian gains 2 Flight Feathers.

cinema.name: 《在春天走进果园》
cinema.description: 累计消耗4点[护羽]时回复1点[飞羽]；处于[薇薇安的预言]下的目标受到的所有属性异常伤害和[紊乱]伤害提升16%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When a total of 4 Guard Feathers are consumed, gain 1 Flight Feather. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG received by targets under Vivian's Prophecy increases by 16%.

cinema.name: 《暴风雨夜，暴风雨夜》
cinema.description: 薇薇安的以太异常积蓄效率提升25%；[异放]从精通中获得的收益提升至原本的130%，且无视目标15%全属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: Vivian's Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 25%. The benefits of Abloom from Anomaly Proficiency are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.

cinema.name: 《另一个，同一个》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 《苇间风》
cinema.description: [普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]和[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中时必定暴击，并使薇薇安的攻击力提升12%，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；进入战场时，薇薇安立即获得5点[护羽]。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension and Basic Attack: Featherbloom will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 Guard Feathers.

cinema.name: 《十四行诗》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 《薇薇安》
cinema.description: 薇薇安造成的以太伤害提升40%；[普通攻击：淑女礼仪·舞步]突进期间触发极限闪避、发动[强化特殊技：堇花悼亡]时，均额外回复1点[飞羽]；发动[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]时会消耗全部[护羽]，下落攻击的范围大幅增加，并在命中时触发一次特殊的[异放]，额外消耗的[护羽]会提高此次[异放]结算的额外异常伤害的比例，最多消耗5点[护羽]，使伤害比例提高至原本的5倍。
cinema.descriptionEn: Vivian's Ether DMG increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz's dash, or using EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem, gain 1 additional Flight Feather. Launching Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension consumes all Guard Feathers, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of Abloom. Each additional Guard Feather consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of Abloom, consuming a maximum of 5 Guard Feathers to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.

basic.name: 普通攻击：翎羽拂击
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
发动第四段攻击后进入[淑女礼仪]状态；
拥有[飞羽]时，在第四段攻击过程中保持按住 【普通攻击键】 可进入[裙裾浮游]状态。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
After triggering the fourth attack, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, holding [Basic Attack] during the fourth attack will activate the Fluttering Frock state.

basic.name: 普通攻击：淑女礼仪·舞步
basic.description:
[淑女礼仪]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前突进攻击，造成以太伤害，并在命中目标时回复1点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
若突进期间触发极限闪避，会额外回复1点[飞羽]；
招式发动后若拥有[飞羽]，会进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 取消。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] while in the Noblewoman state to activate:
Dash forward with an attack that deals Ether DMG and restores 1 Flight Feather upon hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during the dash, gain 1 additional Flight Feather.
If Flight Feathers are available after the skill, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge] when the skill is used.

basic.name: 普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落
basic.description:
[裙裾浮游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动范围攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后消耗全部[飞羽]，每消耗1点[飞羽]，都会获得1点[护羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
在[裙裾浮游]状态下切换角色时，薇薇安会自动发动[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]；
在[裙裾浮游]状态下点按 【闪避键】 可以退出[裙裾浮游]状态。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] while in the Fluttering Frock state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
After activation, this skill consumes all Flight Feathers, and each one consumed grants 1 Guard Feather.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the Fluttering Frock state, Vivian will automatically perform Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension.
While in the Fluttering Frock state, press [Dodge] to exit the state.

basic.name: 普通攻击：落羽生花
basic.description:
队伍中任意角色发动[强化特殊技]命中目标后，薇薇安会消耗1点[护羽]并对目标发动一次[普通攻击：落羽生花]，造成以太伤害，同一招式最多触发一次，这一效果可以在薇薇安处于后场时触发；
[护羽]最多持有5点。
basic.descriptionEn:
After any squad member hits a target with an EX Special Attack, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom against the target, dealing Ether DMG, triggering at most once per use of a skill. This effect can trigger even while Vivian is off-field.
A maximum of 5 Guard Feathers can be stored.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：银刺舞曲
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突刺，造成物理伤害；
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a forward thrust at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：银羽咏叹
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Song of Silver Wings
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速向前方进行攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly attack forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：堇花悼亡
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力攻击，造成大量以太伤害，并回复3点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 进入[淑女礼仪]状态。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a powerful forward attack that deals massive Ether DMG and grants 3 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Enter the Fluttering Frock state after using the skill. Hold [Dodge] during the skill to enter the Noblewoman state.

ultimate.name: 终结技：飞鸟鸣颂
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力攻击，造成大量以太伤害，并回复5点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态，可以通过招式发动时保持长按 【闪避键】 取消。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 5 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill is activated, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge] during the skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：凛羽之护
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后进入[淑女礼仪]状态；
拥有[飞羽]时，在招式发动过程中保持按住 【普通攻击键】 可进入[裙裾浮游]状态。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, hold [Basic Attack] during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

133100003.name: 普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落
133100003.description:
[裙裾浮游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动范围攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后消耗全部[飞羽]，每消耗1点[飞羽]，都会获得1点[护羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
在[裙裾浮游]状态下切换角色时，薇薇安会自动发动[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]；
在[裙裾浮游]状态下点按 【闪避键】 可以退出[裙裾浮游]状态。
133100003.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] while in the Fluttering Frock state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
After activation, this skill consumes all Flight Feathers, and each one consumed grants 1 Guard Feather.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the Fluttering Frock state, Vivian will automatically perform Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension.
While in the Fluttering Frock state, press [Dodge] to exit the state.
